name: Suzhou Ribo Life Science Co
summary: Suzhou Ribo Life Science Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2007 and based in Kunshan, researches and develops new therapies for cardiovascular, metabolic, renal and liver diseases in mainland China and abroad. Its pipeline includes RBD4059 for thrombotic disease, RBD5044 for hypertriglyceridemia and RBD7022 for hypercholesterolemia, all in phase 2, and RBD7007 and RBD2080 for renal disease in phase 1.
